items.title: How Investors May Respond To Duke Energy (DUK) Winning an Emergency Recovery Award for Storm Resilience
items.summary: Duke Energy recently received the Edison Electric Institute’s Emergency Recovery Award for restoring power to nearly 200,000 Carolinas customers after Winter Storm Fern, mobilizing more than 15,000 workers and deploying self-healing grid technology. items.title: Is PG&E Stock Cheap, Or Just Waiting On California?
items.summary: PG&E (PCG) has lost about 13% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%.
